Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the productive conversation this morning. To get Novastar set up in our procurement system and enable PO issuance + ACH/wire payment, we need the buyer intake info and a couple of verification docs. Required fields/documents:
- Legal / registered entity name (exact spelling)
- Registered address (street, city, state, ZIP) and remit-to address (if different)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or VAT number if outside US)
- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form
- ACH details: bank name, routing number, account number (or attach a bank letter confirming account ownership)
- Wire instructions (bank SWIFT/BIC + intermediary bank if applicable)
- PDF bank letter on company letterhead verifying account ownership (preferred)
- Sample invoice format (PDF) showing line items and total amount
- AP contact for invoice submission and PO matching rules (email + name)
- Preferred payment terms (Net30/Net45/etc.) and any PO number requirements

Optional but helpful:
- Remittance contact for electronic remits
- Any vendor codes or buyer-side references you prefer included on the invoice

Attachments can be sent to this thread or directly to invoices@redwood.com if more convenient. Once we receive the docs, our finance team will run the verification, create the vendor record, and confirm the first PO.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
